reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis proposes a W(Cu) solid solution, which is thermodynamically impossible under equilibrium and highly unlikely even under non-equilibrium conditions due to the positive heat of mixing and immiscibility of W and Cu; this fundamentally undermines the proposed mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is well-structured with clear controls, measurements, and a decisive falsification criterion, though the practical feasibility of the CPF treatment and the detection of a W(Cu) solid solution are challenging.
reasons.usefulness: Despite the flawed core mechanism, the hypothesis addresses a critical problem and proposes a novel processing route, which could stimulate useful research if redirected toward more plausible interfacial phenomena like amorphization or nanostructuring.
